Comprehensive Support Throughout the Employee Lifecycle

At IPS Group, we believe that recruitment is more than just finding talent—it’s about providing end-to-end solutions that make hiring seamless and efficient. Hire-to-Retire Solutions: Ultimately, our comprehensive workforce solutions take care of every aspect of employment, eliminating hiring challenges and administrative burdens.

FAQs

1. How does IPS Group manage payroll compliance in India?

IPS Group manages complete payroll compliance for Indian businesses by handling monthly EPF, ESIC, and Professional Tax filings across all major states. Our automated system guarantees 100% adherence to updated statutory labor laws.

2. What is the benefit of outsourcing my Human Resources Function?

HR consultants in Mumbai excel in specialized skills beyond in-house teams. Thus, engaging recruitment agencies ensures expertise in finance, process design, and more. Moreover, they reduce overhead, boost efficiency, and stay updated on legal and tech trends, ensuring top results.

3. What are the recruitment services IPS offers to employers?

Recruitment consultants ensure the right talent for your company through executive searches, ad placement, and specialist recruitment. Additionally, they manage shortlisting, interviews, skill tests, and onboarding. Thus, they handle every step, streamlining the hiring process for your success.

4. Which are the sectors IPS provide services for?

Making informed decisions is vital for employees and visitors involved in various projects. Although clients may suggest solutions, they often lack complete insights. Consequently, recruitment consultants in Mumbai provide data-driven strategies and innovative ideas. Moreover, they assist with hiring, onboarding, and overcoming challenges. Ultimately, their expertise ensures that organizations can make well-rounded decisions that benefit both the workforce and the business.

5. What services Do HR consultants provide?

HR consultants in India assist businesses with tailored solutions for human resources needs. Over time, they become partners, ensuring optimal choices for companies and employees. Moreover, they handle staffing, recruitment, training, audits, and portal management, streamlining HR processes

Integrated Personnel Services (IPS Group) is an end to end human resource management company providing customized solutions to various corporates in India since 2004.

With its strong networks and connections, it serves in 600+ locations, managing nearly about 35000+ associates in pan India. It also has a strong database for International staffing. It deals with 360 degree HR aspects touching upon the most crucial areas of this business.
Undoubtedly, human resources are the backbone of any business, hiring the right people for the right jobs becomes the most vital task. IPS Group, being one of the most trusted HR Consultants in Mumbai, India. We simplify the process of reaching out to the most suitable candidates from all corners of India for its most valued clients.
IPS Group has gradually progressed to stand out from the crowd of other recruitment agencies by developing tools like HRMS applications, mobile apps minimizing the scope of errors in human resource management. It also offers the services in customized packages as per the requirement of the client’s organization.
Understanding the different requirements of industries, IPS Group has been bifurcated its services into 12 different specialized verticals. IPS believes that staffing and manpower consultants must first understand the operations and technicalities of various industries and hence the recruiter’s at IPS Group are domain specialists who understand the knack of providing accurate solutions to the clients in the respective industry.

Raising, Leasing and Management Philosophy:

In Recruitment and staffing, there are three most important aspects is Raising the manpower, which simply means finding the right people.
Then comes Leasing, which means lending our people to work for other companies.
The most important aspect is Management; it covers complete management which includes Documentation, Attendance, Salary & Leave management, Travel, Accommodation, Food, Mobilization, Geo-tagging, and Background Verification.
